records.summary: Copilot Cowork Atlassian integration
records.description: Deliver and validate the Atlassian Rovo MCP v2 connector for Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork. Success means repeatable packaging, durable authentication, and verified Jira read/write workflows.

records.summary: Register Atlassian OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration
records.description: Provision an OAuthPluginVault registration from Atlassian OAuth metadata and bind the generated configuration ID into the M365 manifest. Acceptance: DCR registration is reused on a second provision run.

records.summary: Package the connector with manifest schema v1.28
records.description: Produce a strict v1.28 app package containing icons, connector metadata, and the MCP tool-description artifact. Acceptance: Agents Toolkit validation passes.

records.summary: Generated manifest ID does not match Developer Portal app ID
records.description: The open-plugin importer emitted a deterministic GUID while teamsApp/create generated another app ID, causing teamsApp/update to fail. Resolution: bind manifest.id to TEAMS_APP_ID.

records.summary: Tool-description path with leading dot-slash is rejected
records.description: The package contained the referenced tool file, but publication reported it missing when the manifest path began with ./. Resolution: use the exact ZIP-relative tools path.

records.summary: Validate Rovo MCP v2 discovery and Jira operations
records.description: Verify resource discovery, deferred tool discovery, Jira reads, Jira writes, and confirmation behavior against the SWE and KAN projects.

records.summary: Measure refresh-token durability across Cowork sessions
records.description: Test whether offline_access is granted and whether a new Cowork conversation can reuse the Atlassian connection without reconnecting. Capture timestamps and reconnect prompts.

records.summary: Assess CIMD migration path for the MCP connector
records.description: Document how Client ID Metadata Documents could replace DCR and identify Microsoft 365 support gaps, ownership, and migration prerequisites.

records.summary: Launch information returns 404 after title acquisition
records.description: atk provision acquires a title successfully, but an immediate atk launchinfo request returns NotFound. Determine whether this is propagation delay or a title-service defect.

records.summary: Publish a repeatable connector reproduction runbook
records.description: Document prerequisites, package construction, DCR registration, validation, installation, user consent, test queries, expected evidence, and cleanup.

records.summary: Capture Rovo MCP pilot requirements
records.description: Document pilot users, Atlassian products, required read/write scenarios, tenant constraints, and success measures for the Cowork connector.

records.summary: Complete MCP connector threat model
records.description: Review OAuth token storage, prompt injection boundaries, destructive tool confirmation, audit logging, and least-privilege controls.

records.summary: Review Atlassian OAuth scopes for least privilege
records.description: Map each pilot scenario to Rovo MCP scopes and identify whether the DCR client obtains offline_access and only the required product permissions.

records.summary: Prepare pilot user onboarding checklist
records.description: Define install, Atlassian consent, site selection, first read, first write, reconnect validation, and support escalation steps.

records.summary: Create tenant deployment and rollback runbook
records.description: Document admin publication, allow/block controls, personal versus tenant scope, package versioning, revocation, and uninstall steps.

records.summary: Establish Rovo credit usage baseline
records.description: Run representative search, issue retrieval, and Teamwork Graph scenarios and record credit consumption per call.

records.summary: Monitor connector reconnect frequency
records.description: Track access-token expiry, refresh attempts, reconnect prompts, and session duration across pilot users.

records.summary: Define CIMD readiness gate
records.description: Set acceptance criteria for Microsoft 365 CIMD support, metadata hosting, client identity validation, and migration from existing DCR registrations.

records.summary: Investigate Cowork plugin visibility delay
records.description: Measure the interval between successful title acquisition and availability in Cowork Sources and Skills, including launchinfo propagation behavior.

records.summary: Run pilot go-live review
records.description: Review security findings, authentication durability, functional coverage, support readiness, cost observations, and unresolved platform dependencies.
